| # V6V5 ECU internal reference voltage {#v6v5-ecu-internal-reference-voltage-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                         |                                                                                                                                                      |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The cyclic check of the ECU internal voltage 6.5V

 

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Monitoring of overvoltage for warning.

- Monitoring of overvoltage and undervoltage for error.

- Warning and Error are indicated.

- If battery voltage (supply of ECU) is lower than 7.5V then no error for undervoltage is messaged by this check.

- Over Voltage Error Limit = 8.000V

- Over Voltage Warning Limit = 7.300V

- Under Voltage Error Limit = 5.000V

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

 

- Over Voltage Error (V6V5 \>= Over Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ -----------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_OVErr_VPR6
  Error Code                     0x081100
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  120ms

 

- Over Voltage Warning (V6V5 \>= Over Voltage Warning Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ ------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_OVWarn_VPR6
  Error Code                     0x081200
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   no
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  120ms

 

- Under Voltage Error (V6V5  \<= Under Voltage Error Limit)

  Error                          Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_UV_VPR6
  Error Code                     0x081300
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  120ms
